text:
By OneFootball ,
21 hours ago
😱 Republic of Ireland could fail to show up against Israel! | Image credits : Getty Gavin Bazunu has caused a major stir in the Republic of Ireland squad after announcing that he will not play against Israel.
The goalkeeper expressed his conscientious objection during a team meeting at the training camp. His decision has sparked intense internal debate, leading other players to consider not taking part in the match. Several senior members of the squad are now discussing whether to collectively back their teammate’s stance.
These emergency meetings forced training sessions and press conferences to be delayed. The Irish team’s routine has been completely disrupted on the eve of the trip. Tensions had already been rising following recent comments by head coach Heimir Hallgrímsson about the conflict in Gaza.
His words prompted a sharp diplomatic response from the Israeli federation.
With the clash scheduled to take place at the neutral venue in Debrecen, the group faces crucial hours. The Irish delegation’s final position will depend on a definitive consensus between the dressing room and the officials.
